description: This file defines a React functional component named PassThroughRoutesSelector that renders an Ant Design Select component. It fetches pass-through endpoint routes asynchronously on component mount or when accessToken/teamId change, and allows selecting multiple routes with support for searching and tagging.

methods.name: PassThroughRoutesSelector
methods.description: React functional component that provides a multi-select interface for pass-through routes, fetching data from an external API.
